clue.text: One wouldn't want to draw this inadequate thatching material

definitions.text: One wouldn't want to draw this

parts.note: inadequate means short, not enough
roofs are thatched with straw

explanation.surface: A thatcher grumbles about being sold too little straw, a lot nobody would choose.
explanation.walkthrough: Drawing lots with straws, whoever pulls the short one loses, so nobody wants to draw it.
explanation.definitionFit: When lots are drawn with stalks, the shortest marks the unlucky loser, so nobody hopes to pick it.

clue.text: More tricky storing nothing, for such a person?

definitions.text: More tricky storing nothing, for such a person?

indicators.note: storing means keeping something within, so one piece holds the other

parts.note: more tricky means harder
nothing is zero, the letter O

explanation.surface: Someone who keeps everything finds life harder, yet stores nothing of use.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who stockpiles and keeps things is exactly the person the whole clue describes as storing.

clue.text: In audition, register for part

indicators.note: an audition is a hearing, so the word is identified by how it sounds when spoken

parts.note: a register is a roll, as in a class roll call

explanation.surface: An actor at an audition signs the register for a part in the play.
explanation.definitionFit: An actor's part in a play is the character they are cast to portray.

clue.text: Refuse what one can earn in the southeast

parts.note: SE is the abbreviation for southeast
a wage is what a worker earns

explanation.surface: Someone declines a job because of the pay on offer in southeast England.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Refuse' looks like the verb (to decline) but is the noun, rubbish, pronounced REF-use.
explanation.definitionFit: Refuse is waste matter, and sewers carry away waste water and filth.

clue.text: One served at dodgy dealer

definitions.meaning: in tennis, the player a serve is hit to
a fence, someone who handles stolen goods

explanation.definitionFit: In tennis the player facing the serve has this title, and in crime it names a person who knowingly takes stolen goods.

clue.text: Large animal cry heard

indicators.note: heard means we go by how the word sounds when spoken

parts.note: a wail is a long cry

explanation.surface: A big beast's call carries across the countryside.
explanation.definitionFit: The blue variety of this sea mammal is the largest creature that has ever lived.

clue.text: Rank and file a gross sort, unfortunately

indicators.note: unfortunately suggests things have gone wrong, so the letters before it are jumbled

explanation.surface: Someone sneers that the ordinary members of a party are a coarse bunch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unfortunately' rearranges the letters of A GROSS SORT.
explanation.definitionFit: Ordinary members of a movement, as opposed to its leaders, are called its base or its rank and file.

clue.text: Bird down

definitions.meaning: to down a drink is to gulp it

explanation.definitionFit: It names both a summer migrant songbird and the act of gulping food or drink.

clue.text: Cancel orders for albums

parts.note: to scrap a plan is to cancel it
to book is to order in advance, as with tickets

explanation.surface: A customer calls off orders placed for photo albums.
explanation.definitionFit: These are albums into which cuttings and pictures are pasted as keepsakes.

clue.text: In triumph, carry head of committee

definitions.meaning: to carry someone shoulder-high in celebration
the person who presides over a meeting

explanation.definitionFit: Victors are hoisted shoulder-high this way, and the word also names whoever presides over a committee.

clue.text: Inflamed by love, perform again

parts.note: inflamed skin is red
love is zero in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: A passionate performer is asked for an encore.
explanation.definitionFit: To repeat an action is to carry it out a second time.

clue.text: Single, rambling in America, most unattractive state

indicators.note: in places the jumbled letters inside the other piece

parts.note: US is short for the United States of America

indicators.note: rambling means wandering about, so the letters of the word are rearranged

explanation.surface: An unmarried traveller wandering America finds its least attractive state.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Single' looks like part of the surface's traveller, but it is the fodder for 'rambling'; 'state' hints at a US state yet belongs to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The noun names the condition of being unattractive or unsightly; 'most unattractive state' gives that quality at its extreme.

clue.text: Change say old close friend

parts.note: to change is to alter
say means for example, EG

explanation.surface: Someone describes how an old close friend has changed.
explanation.definitionFit: Latin for 'other self', it means a trusted intimate companion as well as a second personality.

clue.text: Left at sea, extremely lazy and overweight

parts.note: port is the left side of a ship

indicators.note: extremely means taking the extreme letters of the word that follows

explanation.surface: A sailor left aboard ship grows lazy and fat.
explanation.definitionFit: A stout, heavy person is described as rotund or overweight.

clue.text: Not entirely remembering fellow in club

indicators.note: not entirely means only part of the following word is used, the letters sit inside it

explanation.surface: Someone half recalls a man they met at their club.
explanation.definitionFit: A fellow belonging to a club is one of its enrolled participants.

clue.text: Writing full of proud characters

parts.note: proud here means standing up from a surface, so the script is made of raised dots read by touch

explanation.walkthrough: 'proud' suggests arrogance, but in engineering and printing it means projecting, as with raised dots for blind readers.
explanation.definitionFit: This tactile script for blind readers uses patterns of raised dots felt with the fingertips.

clue.text: Solemnly declare place is over border

indicators.note: in a down clue, being over means coming first above the next piece

parts.note: PL is the abbreviation for place, as in street names
a border is an edge

explanation.surface: Someone vows that a place lies across the frontier.
explanation.definitionFit: To vow or promise formally is to give one's word.

clue.text: Honestly confused? Not honestly!

indicators.note: confused means mixed up, so the letters of the word are rearranged

explanation.surface: A puzzled question about honesty is answered with an exclamation that it is anything but.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something secretly or furtively is the opposite of acting openly and honestly.

clue.text: Vagrant putting bit of meat in mouth

indicators.note: in tells us one piece goes inside another

parts.note: trap is slang for mouth, as in 'shut your trap'

indicators.note: a bit of the word means just its first letter

explanation.surface: A homeless man pops a scrap of meat into his mouth.
explanation.definitionFit: A vagrant is a homeless wanderer, also called a hobo or vagabond.

clue.text: Cereal initially sent back

indicators.note: initially means taking the first letter of the word that follows

parts.note: back, as in years back, means ago

explanation.surface: A cereal order was first sent back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sent back' looks like a reversal, but 'back' simply means AGO.
explanation.definitionFit: Starch granules from a palm pith, used in puddings, count as a cereal food.

clue.text: Wind strong at first in stomach

indicators.note: in tells us one piece goes inside another

parts.note: gut means stomach

indicators.note: at first means taking the first letter of the word before

explanation.surface: Someone suffers strong wind in the stomach.
explanation.definitionFit: A sudden brief rush of wind is a blast of air.

clue.text: Church body reported Jack

indicators.note: reported means as spoken, so we go by the sound of the word

parts.note: the nave is the main body of a church

explanation.surface: A church committee has reported someone named Jack.
explanation.definitionFit: In playing cards, the jack is also called by an older name meaning a rogue.

clue.text: Makes a bid for game of tennis

definitions.meaning: in bridge, to make a call that raises the stakes of the opponents' contract

explanation.definitionFit: In bridge this is a call raising scoring stakes, and in tennis it names a match with pairs on each side.

clue.text: Bond secured by appropriate daughter owning land

indicators.note: secured by means held in place by, so this piece sits inside the others

parts.note: appropriate means proper
a bond is a tie

explanation.surface: A father ties a fitting bond for a daughter who holds an estate.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who holds estates or real estate is a landed person.
